title: Pending-changes drill-in lists the registry stamp `_packageId` under "Also changed" for a new object draft, as if the author had added it
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible defect at a public door, captured in a screenshot by the cloud session of objectstack-ai/objectui#12517.

## Symptom (objectui `737592f`, a local HotCRM backend under `objectstack dev --fresh`, a writable package)

Studio › Publish (or Changes) › the pending-changes sheet › a NEW object draft, expanded. Under "Also changed", the drill-in lists `_packageId` beside the author's own keys. `_packageId` is the package stamp the metadata layer writes, not a key the author typed. It is visible in `12517-publish-confirm-light.png` on the never-merged evidence branch: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/a4de5c7d69509c1521ed0f5047f8671417d2da9d/docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/12517/12517-publish-confirm-light.png?raw=true

reach: the Studio pending-changes sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`), also mounted by Home, `DraftPreviewBar` and `CommitTimeline`. Measured on the Studio door only.

## Cause (read, not yet proven at the producer)

- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` (objectui, about :217) passes each body through the spec's `stripReadDecorations` before diffing. That is the right shape, the one objectui#8181 introduced for `_draft` / `_diagnostics`.
- `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS` (objectstack `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-read-decorations.ts:48`) is `['_diagnostics', '_draft']`, so `_packageId` survives the strip.
- Other underscore stamps the registry writes sit beside it in the same read (`_packageVersion`, `_provenance` are destructured together in objectstack `packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts:204`).

## Fix direction (contract-first)

Decide at the producer, not in the panel:
- either the served draft read stops carrying the registry stamps, or the spec's decoration list names them, so `stripReadDecorations` removes them for every consumer;
- a panel-side filter would be a consumer-side narrowing, which the four-axis frame rules out.

Which stamps belong on the list, and whether any consumer reads `_packageId` off a served draft (the CLI's `organization-ownership-apply.ts` reads it off served items), is the producer's measurement to make.

## Acceptance

1. A new object draft's drill-in lists only keys the author set.
2. A pin at the producer: the served draft read, passed through `stripReadDecorations`, carries no registry stamp.
3. CONTROL: an authored key whose name starts with an underscore, if the spec allows one, still shows.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The fix most likely belongs to the metadata protocol and spec owners (objectstack), with the objectui panel unchanged. It came out of objectstack-ai/objectui#12517 and is not part of epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446.

## Dedupe (2026-10-16, MCP `search_issues`)

- objectstack-ai/objectui, "_packageId shown as changed key in pending changes drill-in read decorations stripReadDecorations": 0 hits.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack, "_packageId read decoration METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS draft diff": 13 hits, none this defect. The nearest, objectstack#4326 (read decorations round-tripping into persisted bodies, closed), covers `_diagnostics` / `_draft`.

Filed by seat `domain:ui#4` (session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) from the out-of-scope finding of the objectstack-ai/objectui#12517 report.
